A disk-based cache implementation that persists JSON-serialized objects to the local filesystem, extending `CacheServiceAbs` for use as a fallback or local cache layer.

## Key Components

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `githubCachePath` | Configurable base directory for GitHub API response cache files (`${github.cache.path}`) |
| `httpCachePath` | Configurable base directory for general HTTP response cache files (`${http.cache.path}`) |
| `init()` | `@PostConstruct` method that creates both cache directories on startup |
| `get()` | Reads a JSON file from disk, returning `Optional.empty()` on miss, stale entry, or corruption |
| `put()` | Serializes a value to JSON and writes it to `<cachePath>/<key>.json` |
| `invalidate()` | Deletes the corresponding `.json` file for a given key |
| `getInsertTime()` | Derives cache entry age from the file's last-modified timestamp |
| `getDelimiter()` | Returns `"/"` as the path separator for key construction |

## Usage Example

Cache paths are configured via `application.properties` or environment variables:

```java
# application.properties
github.cache.path=/var/cache/mlg/github
http.cache.path=/var/cache/mlg/http
```

The service is injected by qualifier and used through the `CacheServiceAbs` interface:

```java
@Autowired
@Qualifier("diskCache")
private CacheServiceAbs diskCache;

// Store a value
diskCache.put(diskCache.getGithubCachePath(), "users/torvalds", userObject);

// Retrieve with a 1-hour refresh interval
Optional<GitHubUser> user = diskCache.get(
    diskCache.getGithubCachePath(),
    "users/torvalds",
    new TypeToken<GitHubUser>() {},
    3600_000L
);
```

Stale entries are detected via `lastModifiedTime` and deleted automatically on the next `get()` call. Empty or malformed JSON files are also self-healing — they are deleted and `Optional.empty()` is returned.
